content:
alex: Heads-up — hitting OOM-ish behaviour on longctx PagedAttention runs. Memory grows steadily on H100 after ~10k tokens, but A100 runs fine.

maria: can you paste the repro command and the smallest trace you have?

alex: repro is the pgbench longctx runner, config: --model=rwkv-xl --seq=16384 --batch=1 --kv-page-size=4KB --enable-paged-attn. Added minimal trace below.

alex: ```
kvcache_evict_async: page_id=0x7f9a3b0000 refcount=2 -> enqueue evict
kvcache_free_page: page_id=0x7f9a3b0000 phys=0x55a1c00000 freed=0
pagetable_unmap: page_id=0x7f9a3b0000 owner=0x0 still_refs=1
// later
alloc_vram: size=256MB returned ptr=0x55a1c00200
OOM when allocating 128MB on H100 after 65% GPU memory used
```

sam: hmm "freed=0" and "still_refs=1" looks like a stale ref from the reuse window. Could be race in evict completion vs. page table unmap. Did you get NVTX slices?

alex: yes, NVTX shows kvcache_evict work scheduled, kernel returns, but page_table update callback runs later. On H100 the free path seems delayed (~30ms) vs A100 (~4ms).

ryan: any kernel selection differences between the architectures? We recently landed per-arch kernelselect for tiled-copy that touches the same codepath.

maria: good call — kernelselect: H100 picks the async-tiling variant that uses a batched completion FIFO. If the completion handler runs on a different stream we might be missing a stream-fence before the page table mutation.

alex: stack trace from the eviction worker: ```
worker_thread: kvcache_evict_async -> launch copy kernel (stream=stream_evict) -> enqueue metadata update (stream=stream_meta) -> mark freed
// missing cudaStreamWaitEvent between copy completion and metadata update
```

sam: that matches. On A100 the copy kernel used a synchronous path (different code path) so meta update happened after kernel callback implicitly. On H100 the async tiling broke the implicit ordering.

maria: quick mitigation: insert explicit cudaEvent record on stream_evict and cudaStreamWaitEvent on stream_meta before metadata update. That should serialize free and remove phantom refs. Can you try a patch?

alex: pushed a quick patch to the local runner and reran. Memory ramps but stops at expected plateau. No OOM after 20k tokens. Patch diff: ```
+ cudaEventRecord(ev, stream_evict);
+ cudaStreamWaitEvent(stream_meta, ev, 0);
```

deploy-bot: build 2024.03.15-evict-serialization triggered for alex's patch. CI run queued. :package:

maria: nice. We should also add a unit test that simulates cross-stream evict + delayed completion to avoid regression. Sam — can you own the test?

sam: will do. I'll mock the kernels with configurable completion delay and add to kvcache tests.

ryan: also add a kernelselect invariant check to avoid selecting async-tiling for small pages until we have proper stream fences. This is a policy bandaid but reduces risk.

alex: logging note — monitor-bot reported a ~12% increase in eviction latency when the fence was added (expected) but end-to-end latency stable. monitor-bot prints: ```
monitor-bot: eviction_latency_p50=4.1ms -> 4.6ms; mem_growth_alerts=0; throughput_change=0%
```

maria: ok let's merge the patch + test + kernelselect guard. Postmortem internal doc with root cause = cross-stream ordering gap in H100 async-tiling kernel path.

alex: filing follow-up: check for other places we do metadata updates across streams (cache prefetch, migration). I'll scan the codebase tomorrow.

sam: assigned PR and test. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ryan: thanks all. Good catch, could've been nasty in production. :thumbsup:
